name: llm-gateway
description: 轻量级 LLM 网关管理系统

scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/shared typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/backend typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/worker typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/web typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/e2e typecheck
scripts.test: vitest run --root packages/backend && vitest run --root packages/web && vitest run --root packages/worker
scripts.ast:syntax: ast-grep scan -c rules/ast-grep-rules/.sgconfig.yml --filter syntax-error packages scripts
scripts.ast:esm: ast-grep scan -c rules/ast-grep-rules/.sgconfig.yml --filter esm-relative-specifier-ext packages/backend/src packages/shared/src packages/worker/src packages/e2e

author: SXueckShen <sxueck@outlook.com>
